symptom: The Rose Gold event card shows a blank media panel and a not-loaded badge instead of a photograph.
expected_behavior: A card with multiple supplier photographs automatically presents the first decodable photo even when earlier gallery URLs are stale.
environment: Public VII event availability card reported on 2026-10-20 at mobile width; local candidate branch release/vii-ten-part-polish-20261020.

steps: Request each source and compare response media types.
Trace the shared gallery failure transition.
reproduction.evidence: Rose Gold sources 1-3 return text/html, source 4 returns image/jpeg; the prior hook tested only source 2 after source 1 failed and then stopped.

observations.observation: The catalog contains twelve Rose Gold image URLs.
The first three URLs are not image payloads despite HTTP 200.
observations.evidence: curl content-type checks returned text/html for 5069..., 7369... and 169b... .

hypotheses.mechanism: Consecutive stale supplier URLs stop gallery recovery after only one alternate is tested.
hypotheses.prediction: The first and second sources fail but a later source decodes successfully; old state remains on index 0 with error.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Check sequential content types and trace setImageIndex through usePreviewGallery.
hypotheses.result: Observed exactly: first three are HTML, fourth is JPEG, and the old hook stopped when target index 1 failed.

hypotheses.mechanism: Rose Gold has no usable photos in the supplier catalog.
hypotheses.prediction: Every catalog URL fails image validation.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Request the complete leading source set and inspect content types.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: source 4 and several later sources are valid JPEGs.

fix.change: Make the shared preview loader continue in the requested direction until it finds a decodable image or exhausts the gallery.
fix.evidence: Focused tests cover two consecutive failures followed by success and full exhaustion. A fresh 390px browser reload automatically selected the fourth Rose Gold source at 1027x668 with no error or missing state.

regression_checks.check: Focused image loader and catalog contracts

regression_checks.evidence: 52/52 gallery, loading, map, discovery, interaction and consistency tests passed.
Automatic recovery verified after reload at 390x844 and visually rechecked at 1440x900; valid JPEG displayed with no failure badge.

authorization_boundary: Local repair and verification only; no public deployment without current approval.
